info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Prospect Campaign Review Submission API
info.description: The Prospect Campaign Review Submission API enables businesses to collect and submit customer reviews related to prospect campaign executions. This endpoint allows users to contribute valuable feedback that can enhance marketing strategies and improve sales processes. It is particularly useful for marketing teams and sales professionals who seek to assess the effectiveness of their campaigns through direct customer insights. By leveraging this API, organizations can foster a more responsive and customer-centric approach to their promotional activities.

post.summary: Add a review for a prospect campaign execution.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review for a specific prospect campaign execution identified by its resource ID. The review will be associated with the campaign's performance and insights from the execution phase.
